# France Revisited

> > A cultural blog exploring life in Paris, French gastronomy, art history, and travel throughout France through the lens of American expat experiences.

France Revisited offers personal narratives and cultural insights about living in Paris and traveling across France, featuring profiles of artists like Camille Claudel, chefs like Alain Ducasse and Kei Kobayashi, and explorations of French regions including Provence and Dordogne. Written primarily by Corinne LaBalme and contributors, the site bridges Franco-American cultural perspectives.

## Key Topics

- Paris life and culture
- French gastronomy and dining
- Camille Claudel and French sculptors
- Art history and museums
- Provence and Dordogne regions
- Paris photography
- Expat experiences
- French-American cultural connections
- Michelin-starred chefs
- 19th-century French art
- Palais Royal
- Auguste Rodin
- French culinary traditions
- Urban Paris observations

## French Gastronomy & Dining

- [Stages of the Meal](https://francerevisited.com/2008/09/stages-of-the-meal): Guide to French dining courses and restaurant meal structure
- [Kei Kobayashi: Exceptional French Chefs Aren't Always French](https://francerevisited.com/2019/01/paris-chef-kei-kobayashi): Profile of Michelin-starred Japanese chef Kei Kobayashi in Paris
- [Little Black Easter Eggs: Spring Caviar Comes to Paris](https://francerevisited.com/2013/03/little-black-easter-eggs-spring-caviar-comes-to-paris): Spring caviar season arrives at Paris gourmet shops
- [NoLita, Champs-Élysées: Calamari and Convertibles, Maseratis and Mozzarella](https://francerevisited.com/2013/05/nolita-champs-elysees-calamari-and-convertibles-maseratis-and-mozzarella): Italian restaurant NoLita review at Fiat Motor Village on Champs-Élysées
- [Ethnic Paris: Urban and Suburban Adventures in Indian Restaurants](https://francerevisited.com/2010/05/ethnic-paris-urban-and-suburban-adventures-in-indian-restaurants): Guide to Indian restaurants in Paris and suburbs

## Art & Culture

- [Camille Claudel's Great-Niece Shines Light on the Sculptor's Life and Work](https://francerevisited.com/2017/06/reine-marie-paris-interview-camille-claudel): Interview with Reine-Marie Paris on Camille Claudel Museum opening
- [Van Dyck portraits at the Jacquemart-André](https://francerevisited.com/2008/10/van-dyck-portraits): Van Dyck portrait exhibition review at Jacquemart-André Museum
- [The Vidocq Society: A Famous French Detective Inspires American Forensic Inquiries](https://francerevisited.com/2009/01/the-vidocq-society-a-famous-french-detective-inspires-american-forensic-inquiries): Vidocq Society cold case experts inspired by French detective legacy

## Paris Photography & Visual Essays

- [Paris Photos – Paris Walks: An American Photographer as Flaneur](https://francerevisited.com/2011/07/paris-photos-paris-walks-an-american-photographer-as-flaneur): Review of Peter O'Toole's black-and-white Paris photography book
- [Alternative viewing: France in HDR photography](https://francerevisited.com/2009/10/exploring-france-in-hdr-photography): HDR photography tutorial featuring French landmarks
- [Va-nu-pieds: Returning to Parc de Sceaux](https://francerevisited.com/2010/08/va-nu-pieds-returning-to-parc-de-sceaux): Barefoot photography series at Parc de Sceaux near Paris

## Travel in France

- [Resort Report: Medieval Meets Modern at Le Moulin de Vernègues in Provence](https://francerevisited.com/2013/06/resort-report-medieval-meets-modern-at-le-moulin-de-vernegues-in-provence): Le Moulin de Vernègues resort review between Avignon and Aix
- [On the Farm: WWOOFing in Dordogne, France](https://francerevisited.com/2011/11/on-the-farm-wwoofing-in-dordogne-france): Erica Romkema's organic farm volunteer experience in Dordogne
- [Orléans and New Orleans, Sisters at Last](https://francerevisited.com/2018/01/orleans-new-orleans-sister-cities): Orléans and New Orleans formalize sister city partnership in 2018

## Franco-American Perspectives

- [Je ne suis pas un touriste](https://francerevisited.com/2014/04/je-ne-suis-pas-un-touriste): Expat reflections on tourist vs. resident life in Paris
- [Franco-Philadelphians in Paris](https://francerevisited.com/2009/01/franco-philadelphians-in-paris): Expat profiles exploring Philadelphia-Paris cultural connections
- [Nazi Talk Provides Moral Clarity on Veterans Day—Not](https://francerevisited.com/2010/11/nazi-talk-provides-moral-clarity-on-veterans-day-not): Veterans Day reflection on SNCF's WWII deportation role

## Optional

- [A disturbing thing happened on my street](https://francerevisited.com/2009/09/a-disturbing-thing-happened-on-my-street): Personal observation about Turkish filbert trees in Paris streets
- [Croissants and more at Johnny's Take Out](https://francerevisited.com/2008/12/my-sams-club-croissant-and-other-tastes-from-new-jersey): New Jersey gas station food finds by American expat
- [Teach a man to print stamps and he'll communicate with the world](https://francerevisited.com/2010/02/teach-a-man-to-print-stamps-and-hell-communicate-with-the-world): Cultural observations on French post office customer service
